title: Claude Opus 4.8 and Enhanced Features
description: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8 with improvements across coding and agentic tasks in May 2026. The platform also doubled Claude Code rate limits for developers and introduced enhanced agent usage plans with nested sub-agents, smarter model handling, and new plugin search functionality.

title: Design Mode, Organizations, and Auto-Review
description: Cursor released major updates in June 2026 including Design Mode for browser and canvas editing, multi-select elements, voice input, custom stores and tools in SDK, auto-review run mode, and Organizations for Enterprise customers with improved team management.

title: Microsoft Build 2026 Agent Features and Policy Changes
description: GitHub announced major Copilot updates at Microsoft Build 2026 including agent-native desktop experience, CLI improvements with voice input and rubber duck feature, and new proprietary AI models. On June 1, 2026, GitHub began using Copilot interactions to train their AI models.

title: GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark and GPT-5.3-Codex Launch
description: OpenAI released GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark, a research preview model optimized for real-time coding delivering over 1000 tokens per second, and GPT-5.3-Codex, the most capable agentic coding model. Both models feature stronger reasoning, better collaboration, and 25% faster performance.

title: v0.43.0 with Surgical Code Edits and Session Portability
description: Google released Gemini CLI v0.43.0 featuring surgical code edits using the edit tool, session export and import functionality for portability, and adaptive token estimation for better context management efficiency.
